        .IF     PASS
PASS    equ     1
PASS2   equ     1
        .ENDIF
;
        defmac  PLAYPIT
;
KEY     =       [#5C08]
        .IF     KEY-"q"
YPOS    =       YPOS-1
        .ENDIF
        .IF     KEY-"a"
YPOS    =       YPOS+1
        .ENDIF
        .IF     KEY-"o"
XPOS    =       XPOS-1&31
        .ENDIF
        .IF     KEY-"p"
XPOS    =       XPOS+1&31
        .ENDIF
;
        .IF     YPOS-#FFFF
YPOS    =       23
        .ENDIF
        .IF     YPOS-24
YPOS    =       0
        .ENDIF
        org     32*[LAST+#7001]+[LAST+#7000]+#5800
        defb    ATRFREE
HADR    =       32*YPOS+XPOS+#5800
;
        .IF     [HADR]-ATRSN
GAMEOVER        =       1
        .ENDIF
        .IF     [HADR]-ATRFREE-128
RABBIT          =       0
        .ENDIF
;
        org     HADR
        defb    ATRSN
        org     HEAD+#7000
        defb    XPOS
        defb    YPOS
HEAD    =       HEAD+2&#0FFF
        .IF     FLAG
LAST    =       LAST+2&#0FFF
        .ELSE
FLAG    =       FLAG-1
        .ENDIF
;
        .IF     RABBIT
HADR    =       256*[HEAD+LAST]+[HEAD+LAST+1]&#2FF+#5800
        .IF     [HADR]-ATRFREE
        org     HADR
        defb    ATRFREE+128
RABBIT  =       1
FLAG    =       4
        .ENDIF
;
        .IF     PASS2|GAMEOVER
        PLAYPIT
        .ENDIF
        endmac
;
ATRFREE equ     [#5800]
ATRSN   equ     ATRFREE&7*8+(ATRFREE/8&7)
;
        org     #4000
        defs    256,#FF
        defs    2048-512,#81
        defs    256,#FF
        defs    256,#FF
        defs    2048-512,#81
        defs    256,#FF
        defs    256,#FF
        defs    2048-512,#81
        defs    256,#FF
        org     #5800
        defs    768,ATRFREE
        org     #7000
        defs    #1000
HEAD    equ     4
LAST    equ     0
XPOS    equ     0
YPOS    equ     0
KEY     equ     "p"
HADR    equ     0
GAMEOVER        equ     0
RABBIT  equ     0
FLAG    equ     0
;
        org     #5C08
        defb    "p"
;
        PLAYPIT
;
        .IF     GAMEOVER-1
        display GAMEOVER
TOTALSCORE      equ     HEAD-LAST&#FFF/2
        display TOTALSCORE
        .ENDIF
;
PASS2   =       0
